disposition.reason: This docket is the owners' appeal of a Burlington DRB decision upholding a notice of violation for an unpermitted duplex use at an existing building; it is a municipal appeal, but an appeal of a notice of violation about an existing use is not new housing.

evidence.quote: appeal a decision of the City of Burlington Development Review Board (“DRB”) upholding a Notice of Violation (“NOV”)
The NOV alleges an unpermitted duplex use at property owned by Appellants at 12 Weston Street in Burlington, Vermont
continuously used the Property as a two-unit apartment building, that such use began when the Gadue family converted the Property from a four-unit to a two-unit apartment building in 1977

judgments.note: Every document describes this docket as the owners' appeal of a DRB decision upholding a March 1, 2018 NOV for an unpermitted duplex use; the guide's housing table makes a notice-of-violation appeal not new housing, so the case is excluded.
Appeal of a DRB decision upholding an administrative officer's NOV is a municipal land-use appeal under the guide.

The dispute is whether the City may enforce against a long-standing two-unit use of an existing building (estoppel and the 15-year limit); no new structure or new unit is proposed in this docket. The 2014 interior reconfiguration belonged to the separate docket 120-8-14 Vtec and did not add a unit.

history.note: Excluded: appeal of a DRB decision upholding an NOV for unpermitted duplex use; not new housing.
